name: Skeleton
summary: A greyed placeholder that holds a component's shape while its content loads.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-skeleton> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Skeleton is a FAMILY of building blocks: `variant` picks the shape — text · paragraph (N rows, last one shorter) · title · avatar · button · input · image (a framed picture placeholder with a muted glyph). `rows` sets the paragraph line count, `round` softens button/input corners to the pill, `active` toggles the shimmer — an opacity PULSE (no gradient fill, per the no-gradient rule). Compose avatar + title + paragraph for the common list-item shape. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: variant

props.desc: Soften button/input/image corners to the pill

whenToUse.when: content is loading and you want to hold its exact layout to avoid a jump
a short, indeterminate wait where the final shape is unknown

opinion.note: Match the skeleton to the real content's shape and size so nothing shifts when it resolves. Use it for the first load of a region; don't stack many pulsing blocks for a sub-second wait — a Spin is calmer.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Skeleton component-set (Design System V3 / 'Sceleton', fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy) + antd Skeleton building blocks: paragraph (N rows, last shorter), title, avatar (round bust), button, input, and image (framed picture placeholder), plus an `active` shimmer and `round` corners. The common composite is avatar + title + paragraph (a list item). Token layer: fill gray-30, image glyph gray-50, radius-xs default / radius-default for controls / radius-pill for avatar + round. Shimmer is an opacity pulse, NOT a gradient, to honour the no-gradient-on-fills rule.
